change: Bind the original WASM request ID, wait for its loadingFinished event, and hash exactly one Network.getResponseBody result without Playwright body fallback or URL refetch. Drain after the original pixel/export checks and before context closure, preserving the first failure.

verification.pinnedPlaywrightClosureEvent: CDPSession2 channel close emits close; independently checked in pinned primary implementation

limitations: This establishes exact-request response semantics, not Liquid GPU acceptance.
Buffer eviction, incomplete transfers, malformed or unavailable bodies fail closed without refetch.
A started CDP command with no reply or closure still depends on existing outer supervision; no new helper timeout is introduced.
